caption: A spotted ray with blue and orange markings rests on a rocky seabed scattered with coral fragments and small stones, under dim, focused lighting against a dark background.

A blue bird with a blue head, blue body, and grayish wings stands on a dark asphalt surface, pecking at scattered brown seeds, with green grass visible in the background and a dark curved object partially framing the right side of the image.

White computer keyboard with visible keys including "B", "N", "M", "J", "K", "U", "I", "H", "C", and function labels "Bold", "Italics", "Underline" on respective keys; keys show slight wear and dust accumulation; close-up shot with shallow depth of field emphasizing central keys.

A dense cluster of bright yellow lemons and oranges, their textured rinds glistening under even lighting, tightly packed together with some fruits partially obscured by others, creating a vibrant, citrus-filled composition.
A brown Weimaraner dog with short smooth coat and droopy ears resting on a red fabric surface, gently holding a black and white plush cow toy with pink stitched nose and smiling mouth in its mouth.

Black Land Rover Freelander SUV parked on a paved lot, featuring a roof rack, silver alloy wheels, and a visible license plate reading "LS54 WMC". A red and white "Every Day Love Singles" price sticker with "£6271" is affixed to the windshield. Background includes other parked cars, a green sign reading "BEAT ANY DEAL", and a white vehicle partially visible behind the SUV.
A snow-capped mountain peak with jagged, rocky ridges, partially obscured by low-hanging clouds, surrounded by a vast glacier with crevasses and patches of exposed dark rock, under an overcast sky.
A red, textured fungal growth emerging from the ground, surrounded by dry, brown leaves and twigs, with a pale pinkish stem and a rough, cracked cap.
A tabby cat is sleeping on a white pillow inside a quiet library.
A collie stands beside a red tractor in a green valley.
A red panda sits on a wooden swing in a green forest.
A guinea pig sits in a wicker basket inside a greenhouse.
